research_end_to_end_reexecution: PARTIAL - 2026-11-04, and the part that is missing is now measured rather than pending. The whole pipeline was re-executed with tools/run_pipeline.py in a separate tree expanded from git archive v0.2.0, with its own environment built from paper/requirements-manuscript.txt, so nothing it wrote could reach a frozen result: 22 stages, 7.1 hours, from the XCOM and SpekPy reference tables through both training arms to the 60-slice walnut evaluation, then compared leaf by leaf with tools/compare_results.py. Everything that does not pass through a trained network reproduces exactly, at a tolerance of zero: quantitation_baseline (160 leaves), detectability_spectrum (915), tv_eval (670), both walnut noise models with their npz arrays and meta. The training data regenerates byte-identical, 384 of 384 files in each arm. Nothing downstream of training reproduces: all three weight files differ, and so do denoised_eval, denoised_eval_d2, sensitivity_eval, both walnut evaluations and the walnut summary. The cause is not float noise and not the environment. SEED reached a local torch.Generator covering batch order and crop offsets, while the convolution weights were initialised from the global torch RNG, which nothing seeded; two 150-step runs on one machine with one seed and identical data differed in all 46 tensors and in the step-150 training loss (14209.86 against 14246.38). tools/train_denoiser.py and tools/train_denoiser_walnut.py now seed the global RNG through seeded_model(), pinned by tests/test_training_seeding.py and proved by removing the seed again. The weights shipped in v0.2.0 predate that repair and cannot be regenerated by it; they are archived with the release, and clean_new_environment_figure_rebuild separately proved that every shipped figure redraws from them byte-identically. The re-execution also found two defects in the released code: denoised_eval.py wrote the merged result to the working directory rather than results/ when --final was given a bare name, which is the command in its own docstring (fixed, tests/test_eval_output_paths.py), and tv_weight_selection.py's default candidate list is not the one that produced the committed selection. What is still not re-executed is the 19 GB walnut download, tools/fetch_reconstructions.py
